angular-accel.name: Angular Acceleration Calculator
angular-accel.intro: Compute average angular acceleration α = Δω/Δt from a change in angular velocity and the elapsed time, for rotational motion analysis.

angular-displacement.name: Angular Displacement Calculator
angular-displacement.intro: Compute angular displacement θ = ω₀t + ½αt² from initial angular velocity, angular acceleration and time.

angular-final-velocity.name: Final Angular Velocity Calculator
angular-final-velocity.intro: Compute final angular velocity ω = ω₀ + αt from initial angular velocity, angular acceleration and time.

angular-velocity.name: Angular Velocity Calculator
angular-velocity.intro: Convert between linear and angular velocity using ω = v/r, including the equivalent rotation speed in rpm.

avg-acceleration.name: Average Acceleration Calculator
avg-acceleration.intro: Compute average acceleration a = (v − v₀)/t from the change in linear velocity over a time interval.

avg-velocity.name: Average Velocity Calculator
avg-velocity.intro: Compute average velocity v̄ = Δx/Δt from displacement and elapsed time, distinct from average speed.

displacement-accel.name: Uniformly Accelerated Displacement Calculator
displacement-accel.intro: Compute displacement x = v₀t + ½at² from initial velocity, acceleration and time.

displacement-va.name: Displacement from Velocities Calculator
displacement-va.intro: Compute displacement s = (v² − v₀²)/(2a) from final velocity, initial velocity and acceleration without needing time.

final-velocity-accel.name: Final Velocity Calculator (Uniform Acceleration)
final-velocity-accel.intro: Compute final velocity v = v₀ + at from initial velocity, acceleration and elapsed time.

free-fall-time.name: Free Fall Time Calculator
free-fall-time.intro: Compute fall time t = √(2h/g) from drop height and gravitational acceleration, with support for different gravity environments.

freq-from-omega.name: Frequency from Angular Velocity
freq-from-omega.intro: Convert angular velocity to rotational frequency using f = ω/(2π), returning hertz.

height-fall-distance.name: Free Fall Distance Calculator
height-fall-distance.intro: Compute fall distance h = ½gt² from fall time and gravitational acceleration (9.81 m/s² by default).

period-from-omega.name: Period from Angular Velocity
period-from-omega.intro: Convert angular velocity to rotational period using T = 2π/ω, returning seconds.

projectile-max-height.name: Projectile Maximum Height Calculator
projectile-max-height.intro: Compute the peak height of an oblique projectile H = v²sin²θ/(2g) from launch speed and elevation angle.

projectile-time-flight.name: Projectile Time of Flight Calculator
projectile-time-flight.intro: Compute total flight time of an oblique projectile returning to the same level using t = 2v·sinθ/g.

projectile-velocity-components.name: Projectile Velocity Components Calculator
projectile-velocity-components.intro: Resolve launch velocity into horizontal vₓ = v·cosθ and vertical v_y = v·sinθ components.

relative-velocity-1d.name: 1D Relative Velocity Calculator
relative-velocity-1d.intro: Compute relative velocity v_rel = v₁ − v₂ for two objects moving along the same line, for pursuit and reference-frame problems.

relativistic-velocity-add.name: Relativistic Velocity Addition Calculator
relativistic-velocity-add.intro: Combine velocities in the relativistic regime using (u+v)/(1+uv/c²), which never exceeds the speed of light.

rpm-to-radps.name: RPM to Rad/s Converter
rpm-to-radps.intro: Convert rotation speed in revolutions per minute to angular velocity using ω = 2π·n/60.

stopping-distance.name: Braking Distance Calculator
stopping-distance.intro: Compute total stopping distance combining driver reaction distance and braking distance for given speed, reaction time and deceleration.

stopping-time.name: Braking Time Calculator
stopping-time.intro: Compute braking time t = v₀/a from initial speed and deceleration rate.

tangential-accel.name: Tangential Acceleration Calculator
tangential-accel.intro: Compute tangential acceleration a_t = α·r from angular acceleration and rotation radius.

tangential-velocity.name: Tangential Velocity Calculator
tangential-velocity.intro: Compute tangential linear velocity v = ω·r from angular velocity and radius.

uniform-displacement.name: Uniform Motion Displacement Calculator
uniform-displacement.intro: Compute displacement s = v·t for uniform linear motion from constant speed and time.

velocity-squared.name: Velocity-Displacement Calculator
velocity-squared.intro: Compute final velocity without time using v² = v₀² + 2ax from initial velocity, acceleration and displacement.
